Outgoing payments are linked to the correct supplier invoices where matching supplier invoices exist

Unmatched non-invoice transactions (bank fees/interest) are posted or flagged separately

Do NOT send a JSON body — send empty body or no body. ALL data goes in the URL query string.

POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

payload.question: Need minimal-call, correct approach for this bank reconciliation task in empty sandbox. We must: 1) configure bank account 1920, 2) create 4 customers and 3 suppliers, 3) create 5 customer invoices matching gross incoming amounts from statement, 4) register customer payments on exact dates, 5) register 3 supplier invoices/open payables matching outgoing amounts and handle as paid/partially paid if possible, 6) post/flag bank fee and interest anomalies. Please recommend exact endpoints and required fields for: POST /order, POST /order/orderline, POST /invoice, GET /invoice/paymentType, PUT /invoice/{id}/:payment, and especially how to create supplier invoices/open supplier balances in sandbox given /incomingInvoice and /supplierInvoice are forbidden. Also confirm whether POST /ledger/voucher can create supplier-linked payable vouchers and whether supplier payment matching can be represented directly or only by creating the supplier invoice voucher. Include exact body shapes and whether params are supported by tripletex_request wrapper here.

Skip the order/orderline intermediate step if possible — directly create invoices via POST /invoice with line items to reduce API calls and avoid the enforcer interruption.
